contributions.statement: When agents draft ADRs or specs from meeting transcripts, ground retrieval only in the team's own decision records and require a transcript citation per claim; retrieval over other projects' ADRs inserted invented figures and tentative discussions were promoted to accepted decisions.
contributions.evidence: §5.1, §5.3, §7: traced examples ('500 concurrent connections and 5000+ DAU' from an unrelated ADR, '93% industry adoption'); 5 transcripts, not quantified.
relative_to: irrelevant retrieved context harms faithfulness (known RAG failure)

reason: A feasibility study on five student-heavy transcripts; the RAG-contamination failure is relevant to drafting specs during an SDD rollout but is shown by anecdote, not rate.
